contributions.detail: 17 Form A rows sum to exactly 6,550.00 = cover line 1 (contributions of donors who gave more than $50.00). The TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT column is blank on every line, so THIS and CUMULATIVE coincide (first report of the cycle) - scope recorded as cumulative.
